aurvek_privacy_policy_how_we_collect_use: Aurvek Privacy Policy - How we collect, use, and protect your data.
aurvek_we_us_our_operates_the_aurvek: Aurvek ("we", "us", "our") operates the {tag_a}example.com{tag_b} platform. This policy explains what data we collect, why, and how we protect it.
email_address_used_for_account_creation_: {tag_a}Email address{tag_b} — used for account creation, login via magic link, and transactional notifications.
username_chosen_by_you_or_auto_generated: {tag_a}Username{tag_b} — chosen by you or auto-generated during registration.
password_if_you_choose_password_based_au: {tag_a}Password{tag_b} — if you choose password-based authentication, stored as a salted bcrypt hash. We never store or see your plaintext password.
google_account_data_if_you_sign_in: {tag_a}Google account data{tag_b} — if you sign in with Google, we receive your Google ID, email, and display name via OAuth 2.0. We do not access your contacts, calendar, or any other Google data.
optional_chatgpt_connection_if_you_choos: {tag_a}Optional ChatGPT connection{tag_b} — if you choose to connect your own ChatGPT subscription, OpenAI provides a Codex authorization credential to Aurvek. We store that credential encrypted, together with limited plan and model-catalog metadata, so your own requests can use the models available to your account. This is separate from signing in to Aurvek.
payments_are_processed_by_stripe_we_do: Payments are processed by {tag_a}Stripe{tag_b}. We do not store credit card numbers, CVVs, or full card details on our servers.
we_store_transaction_records_amounts_dat: We store transaction records (amounts, dates, references) for accounting and dispute resolution.
conversations_and_messages_you_create_wi: {tag_a}Conversations and messages{tag_b} you create within the platform, including AI responses.
files_you_upload_images_audio_documents_: {tag_a}Files you upload{tag_b} (images, audio, documents) for use within conversations.
token_usage_and_costs_for_billing_purpos: {tag_a}Token usage and costs{tag_b} for billing purposes.
ip_address_for_rate_limiting_abuse_preve: {tag_a}IP address{tag_b} for rate limiting, abuse prevention, and security.
session_cookie_a_jwt_token_for_authentic: {tag_a}Session cookie{tag_b} — a JWT token for authentication. HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, and Secure when served over HTTPS.
visitor_cookie_an_anonymous_analytics_id: {tag_a}Visitor cookie{tag_b} — an anonymous analytics identifier for landing pages. No personal data.
we_do_not_use_third_party_tracking: We do not use third-party tracking cookies or advertising cookies.
to_provide_maintain_and_improve_the_plat: To provide, maintain, and improve the platform.
to_process_payments_and_maintain_transac: To process payments and maintain transaction history.
to_send_transactional_emails_login_links: To send transactional emails (login links, payment confirmations). We do not send marketing emails without explicit consent.
to_enforce_our_terms_prevent_abuse_and: To enforce our terms, prevent abuse, and ensure platform security.
we_use_the_following_third_party_service: We use the following third-party services that may process your data:
ai_providers_openai_anthropic_google_xai: {tag_a}AI Providers{tag_b} (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI) — your conversation messages are sent to the provider and model you select to generate AI responses. If you connect a ChatGPT subscription, those text conversations and usage are processed by OpenAI under the terms and data controls of your connected account. Each provider has its own privacy policy and data handling practices.
stripe_payment_processing_subject_to_str: {tag_a}Stripe{tag_b} — payment processing. Subject to {tag_c}Stripe's Privacy Policy{tag_d}.
cloudflare_cdn_ddos_protection_and_dns_s: {tag_a}Cloudflare{tag_b} — CDN, DDoS protection, and DNS. Subject to {tag_c}Cloudflare's Privacy Policy{tag_d}.
google_oauth_authentication_only_subject: {tag_a}Google OAuth{tag_b} — authentication only. Subject to {tag_c}Google's Privacy Policy{tag_d}.
elevenlabs_text_to_speech_and_voice_feat: {tag_a}ElevenLabs{tag_b} — text-to-speech and voice features, if enabled.
data_is_stored_on_servers_we_control: Data is stored on servers we control. Database access is restricted and encrypted at rest.
passwords_are_hashed_with_bcrypt_and_a: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt and a unique pepper. We cannot recover your password.
api_keys_and_secrets_are_stored_in: API keys and secrets are stored in environment variables, never in source code.
connected_chatgpt_credentials_are_encryp: Connected ChatGPT credentials are encrypted at rest with a dedicated encryption key. A plaintext credential is created only in a private, short-lived runtime directory during connection or a request and is removed during teardown.
we_implement_rate_limiting_ip_based_abus: We implement rate limiting, IP-based abuse detection, and progressive banning for security.
account_data_is_retained_as_long_as: Account data is retained as long as your account is active.
conversation_data_can_be_deleted_by_you: Conversation data can be deleted by you at any time through the chat interface.
you_can_disconnect_chatgpt_at_any_time: You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time. Aurvek immediately blocks the connected credential and asks Codex to sign out. If sign-out cannot yet be confirmed, the credential remains encrypted solely so Aurvek can retry revocation; it cannot be used for chat. Once confirmed, Aurvek replaces it with a token-free revocation record. Limited non-secret connection metadata may remain for security auditing until account deletion.
if_you_request_account_deletion_we_will: If you request account deletion, we will remove your data within 30 days, except where legally required to retain it (e.g., financial transaction records).
correct_inaccurate_data_via_your_profile: {tag_a}Correct{tag_b} inaccurate data via your profile settings.
export_your_conversation_data_pdf_mp_for: {tag_a}Export{tag_b} your conversation data (PDF, MP3 formats available).
to_exercise_these_rights_contact_us_at: To exercise these rights, contact us at the email below.
aurvek_is_not_directed_at_children_under: Aurvek is not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we will delete it.
we_may_update_this_policy_from_time: We may update this policy from time to time. Significant changes will be communicated via the platform. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.
